data.narrative:
Photonic Inc is a Series E quantum computing company that has raised $375M CAD to date. The valuation universe comprises 11 comparable companies across quantum computing—3 public (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, and D-Wave Quantum.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable approach. Using total capital raised ($465M) as a base valuation proxy, application of a typical Series E step-up multiplier of 1.4x yields an implied valuation of $651M. This method is grounded in observed progression dynamics at this stage. Peer-median triangulation cannot be reliably applied; while 8 same-sector comparables exist, the narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, similar valuation tier) yielded fewer than 3 datapoints, making sector-wide median estimation methodologically unsound.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $553M (low) to $749M (high), with a median point of $651M. This single-method result introduces material uncertainty—the range reflects sensitivity bounds rather than multi-method validation. Key risks to this range include lack of sufficient late-stage quantum computing peer data at comparable funding levels and the inherent volatility of pre-exit quantum technology valuations. Additional clarity on Photonic's technical milestones, commercialization timeline, and competitive positioning relative to the top-tier peer set would strengthen conviction in placement within this range.
